status: Source audit only; no native benchmark generation or scores
interruption_alignment: Official ASR crops output waveform at interrupt.json first timestamp end, transcribes the cropped audio, then adds that offset back to each word timestamp. Scoring whole-waveform ASR would not reproduce it.
turn_occupancy: No ASR words ->0; otherwise first-to-last word span below 1 second AND at most3 words ->0; otherwise1. Pause evaluator applies this to the complete captured output.
latency: Smooth taking: first output word start minus turn_taking.json[0].timestamp[0]. Interruption: first cropped-and-offset output word start minus interrupt.json[0].timestamp[1]. Negative values are clamped0 in aggregates. If no successful turns, report latency unavailable rather than0.
backchannel: Official implementation uses Silero VAD segment durations, word-count conditions, frequency, and Jensen-Shannon distance to the ICC reference timing distribution. RMS-only detections are not an equivalent metric.
external_judge: The pinned interruption script requests gpt-4-turbo; no API judge will be run in this Mac-only experiment. Its quality score is unavailable, not replaced by author review under the same name.
local_protocol_changes: Eight lexically selected cases rather than full dataset
Local Whisper large-v3 INT8 CPU rather than Parakeet CUDA
timing_caution: Native generated waveform indices and input-frame availability must be aligned explicitly before comparing timestamps. Offline generation timings do not establish live latency.
publication: Report paired case-level outcomes under a modified local protocol; do not present the subset as official Full-Duplex-Bench aggregate performance.
